reviews.title: Beware
reviews.text: I’ve had the same account before the transition from textplus, over 10 years. My account was recently locked and I provided proof of transaction ID that the account belongs to me. Customer service said the account was unlocked and they replied with an email that doesn’t belong to me and said to use it to log into my account. I replied but they didn’t respond. If I provided proof that the account belongs to me, I shouldn’t have to jump through hoops to get it back. They could’ve easily changed the email to my email but they chose not. I’ll be using another texting app moving forward.

reviews.title: Same issues for months now!!
reviews.text:
I first installed the app a couple months back after seeing an ad for it. I tried signing up then, but it kept telling me ‘app isn’t available in my current region.’ Mind you, I was living in Florida at the time — and if it isn’t available in the U.S., I honestly don’t know where else it would be.

It’s November now, I’ve moved up to NJ, and I’m still getting the same region error. The app’s fully updated, and I’m using a high-end iPhone, so I know that isn’t the issue. Just comes off as a poorly built app overall.

Really disappointed, too, because I had high hopes for it when I first saw the ad all those months ago.

reviews.title: Not for use overseas!
reviews.text: Please do not get this app if you intend to use it overseas at all. No matter how fast your Internet connection is you’ll have awful lag.  That’s at best and at worst you won’t even be able to hear the other person because the line is so crackly. Much better options out there.  Wasted $40 on an annual subscription.
